title: Savory Chinese Dumplings
description: A savory and crumbly gluten-free dumpling recipe inspired by Chinese flavors. This dish combines crunchy pistachio and savory goodness.
instructions: 1. In a large mixing bowl, combine ground pork, pistachio meal, savory crumbly mix, chopped scallions, gluten-free soy sauce, Chinese five-spice powder, and salt. Mix well.
2. Gradually add water to the mixture and mix until a dough forms.
3. Divide the dough into small balls and flatten each ball into a disk shape.
4. Place a small spoonful of the pork mixture in the center of each disk.
5. Fold the dough over the filling and press the edges together to seal the dumpling.
6. Repeat with the remaining dough and filling.
7. Heat 1/4 cup of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
8. Add the dumplings to the skillet and cook until the bottoms are golden brown.
9. Add 2 cups of water to the skillet and bring to a boil.
10. Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 5-7 minutes or until the water has been absorbed and the dumplings are cooked through.
11. Serve the dumplings hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
